sentences.text: Shhh... in the ironing room, I felt the faint signs of a presence starting at 05:00.
The air thickening slowly, the temperature rose from its expected range of 20.7 °C to 21.1 °C.
Oh, the sudden warmth with no source intensified, peaking sharply at 05:40 with a reading of 21.6 °C.
And just like that, the shift faded out by 06:00, leaving a trace of that strange, unexpected heat.
